title: Market Reference Basis for the Rack of Record on a Refined Fuels and Propane Account
content:
The rack of record on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is taken from what the member has actually been billed on its will-call stops, and the programme's posted price margin is taken off whichever price stands. In every case the result is taken to four decimal places.

**What a will-call stop is.** A will-call stop is one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking.

**Where 2 or more will-call stops were billed on the account in the three months ending on the handling date**, the rack of record is the average of the prices billed on those stops less the programme's posted price margin. The average is the plain average of the prices billed per gallon on the will-call stops falling in that window.

**Where no will-call stop was billed in that window and the gallons booked on the account reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons**, the rack of record is the price the gallons were booked at less the programme's posted price margin.

**In every other case**, the rack of record is the price billed on the most recent will-call stop, less the programme's posted price margin.

## The three lines set against one another

| Will-call stops billed in the three months ending on the handling date | Gallons booked | The price the margin comes off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | Any figure | The average of the prices billed on those stops |
| None | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The price the gallons were booked at |
| None | Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The price billed on the most recent will-call stop |
| Exactly 1 | Any figure | The price billed on the most recent will-call stop |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

*Two stops in the window.* An account on a programme whose posted price margin is 0.80 USD per gallon carries two will-call stops in the three months ending on the handling date, billed at 2.1000 and 2.3000 USD per gallon. The average is 2.2000, and the rack of record is 2.2000 less 0.8000, coming to 1.4000 USD per gallon.

*One stop in the window.* The same account with a single will-call stop in that window, billed at 2.3000, takes the price on the most recent will-call stop: 2.3000 less 0.8000, coming to 1.5000 USD per gallon.

*No stop in the window.* The same account with no will-call stop in that window, whose gallons booked reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons and which booked at 2.4000 USD per gallon, takes 2.4000 less 0.8000, coming to 1.6000 USD per gallon.
